html_source: Photograph of unknown date, looking south along Westland Row from a point just north of the train station entrance and the Loopline railway overpass. The post office was in the left foreground in 1904, and the tea shop in the right foreground, both of them below the overpass. Sweny's pharmacy (invisible) was at the far end.
